items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And on that Saturday, there would be a concert with the Batistas. Alvin played, Harold played, I played... And all the Batistas brothers and their sons and everything. All of us played.

ctx.x: You know, we was talking a while back about the Batistas and how many Batistas there are. I'll tell you, this is not a joke, this is a reality what happened. Four years ago, there was preparation for the Jazz Fest. It was a Thursday night. And on that Saturday, there would be a concert with the Batistas. Alvin played, Harold played, I played, I think it was a drummer that played. And all the Batistas brothers and their sons and everything. All of us played. It was about 27 or 28 of us, you know. That Thursday…

items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Alvin played, Harold played, I played... All of us played. It was about 27 or 28 of us... That Thursday night, we went to the Musicians Hall and we had a rehearsal.

ctx.x: There's Earl Baptiste. Quentin. Earl Quentin Baptiste who's gone. There's Alvin Baptiste. There's Harold Baptiste. There's Lionel Baptiste. There's the whole Baptiste brothers family.
